order_note: Predecessor SQL 91, which SQL 116 supersedes. SQL 116 needs public.moov_onboarding_profiles (SQL 91) owned by checksops_admin. Moov requires an industry on a business account's profile (profile.business.industry, a value from Moov's GET /industries list); ChecksOps had nowhere to keep it, and on staging 2026-10-26 Moov's form for Freedom Adjustment's new sandbox account listed Industry as required and empty. SQL 116 adds one nullable column, moov_onboarding_profiles.industry text, with no default and no column grant (SQL 91's table grants to checksops and authenticated cover it), and changes nothing else: no constraint (the API validates the value), policy, function, trigger or row. SQL 91 fingerprints that table's full column list, so after SQL 116 SQL 91 counts as applied by SQL 116's fingerprint (spec supersedes, as SQL 93 by SQL 96); SQL 104, 105 and 109 keep their SQL 91 predecessor. The API code that writes and sends the column is a later change and reads it only once SQL 116 is applied. If the read-only inspect reports already_applied true nothing is applied.
